officialText:
Section 230.30(A) – Revise the Exception in Section 230.30(A) to read as follows:

Exception: DELETED.

Section 230.30(B) – Add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 230.30(B) to read as follows:

Informational Note: The utility company may have more stringent requirements regarding the use of PVC conduits.

Section 230.30(B)(7) – Revise Item (7) in the list of items in Section 230.30(B) to read as follows:

(7)DELETED.
